summary: Additive position-management modules verified. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed. GET /api/config exposes all 13 new fields with correct defaults (timeout_15m=14, timeout_1h=7, timeout_4h=5, timeout_1d=3, timeout_min_r=0.3, breakeven_safety_pct=0.05, default_fee_rate=0.001, trailing_activation_r=1.0, trailing_atr_mult=1.2, partial_close_enabled=true, partial_close_r=1.0, partial_close_pct=35.0, liq_min_distance_pct=25.0). PUT /api/config persists a changed field (timeout_1h=6) and GET returns it. POST /api/paper/trading-mode {spot} + /paper/reset + /paper/execute/{signal_id} for a 1h LONG signal opens a position with new schema fields: current_stop == stop_loss, initial_risk == |fill_price - stop_loss| > 0, breakeven_active=false, trailing_active=false, partial_closed=false. GET /api/paper/portfolio returns positions with the same new fields. Regression endpoints (/signals, /setup-debug/log, /stop-debug/log, /slippage/log, /feed/status) all return 200; signals schema unchanged (score, max_score=8, atr>0, reversal_signals present). Frontend: mobile viewport (375x667) Portfolio tab loads without crash, no React Native red screen; PositionCard correctly renders Entry/Now/SL/TP/Close and mgmt badges are conditional (none at open, as expected).
critical_code_review_comments: compute_breakeven: fee_cost is computed as entry*(maker+taker) which is a RATE addition, not a dollar cost per notional. This matches spec ('fee_maker+fee_taker as rate*entry'). OK.

get_funding_rate: contract symbol mapping uses simple '-' strip which likely 404s on KuCoin futures endpoint for most spot pairs; acceptable per spec (silent fallback to 0). Consider mapping to 'XBTUSDTM' style contracts if leverage is scoped in a future pass.

manage_open_position runs on every 3s monitor tick; get_trade_fees is cached per symbol (good), _current_spread and get_funding_rate hit KuCoin every call until BE actually triggers. Minor: could gate compute_breakeven behind timeout precondition to reduce external calls.
apply_trailing_manager updates last_trail_candle_t even when no trailing change is applied (fine to prevent re-fetch), but could still be missed if the manage_open_position fails between.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use existing live signals from KuCoin scans and clean up (paper/reset) after opening a test position.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Position-management modules (TimeoutManager, BreakevenCalculator, TrailingStopManager, partial close) are additive and verified at the schema/config level for SPOT 1h. Leverage/liquidation and time-elapsed BE/trailing triggers were intentionally out of scope. If leverage testing is added later, verify KuCoin futures funding-rate contract-symbol mapping (BTC-USDT -> XBTUSDTM style, currently only strips '-').
